review.reviewer: Claude Code (Achmage Presentation remake session) with instructor feedback on 2026-11-16
review.claims: All 70 slides keep the 2024 wording and order of the week-6 slides 6W-1 and 6W-2 with typo and quotation-mark fixes only; 6W-1 slide 21 takes the instructor-corrected version from 6W-2 slide 6. The R results are the actual output of running the slide code in R 4.3.3, and the t-test output is split onto the next slide so code and result fit a 16:9 slide. On instructor request the GIF of slide 14 is replaced by the same scene as a YouTube video. No new factual claims are added.
review.images: Re-drawn collages of the 2024 slide pictures (candy box, fists, the type I/II error table, the normal-curve p-value figure and the 명서등비 staircase) in light and dark variants, photographs or illustrations from the 2024 course slides, whose original sources are not recorded there, and a drawn still that names the YouTube video. Picture descriptions are also given as body text.
review.links: External links named on the slides: the YouTube video of slide 14 (youtu.be/lK4ouRWGHHI). Its response status is recorded separately.
